mapper.select: select id, name, season from golf_contests where id = #{contestId}

select U.id userId, U.username userUsername, U.image userImage, (select coalesce(sum(R2.prize_money), 0) from golf_picks P2 join golf_tournament_results R2 on R2.tournament_id = P2.tournament_id and R2.golfer_id = P2.golfer_id where P2.contest_id = E.contest_id and P2.user_id = E.user_id) totalPrizeMoney, (select count(*) from golf_picks P3 where P3.contest_id = E.contest_id and P3.user_id = E.user_id) picksMade, P.id pickId, T.id pickTournamentId, T.name pickTournamentName, G.id pickGolferId, G.name pickGolferName, case when exists (select 1 from golf_tournament_results R3 where R3.tournament_id = P.tournament_id) then coalesce(R.prize_money, 0) end pickPrizeMoney from golf_contest_entries E join users U on U.id = E.user_id left join golf_picks P on P.contest_id = E.contest_id and P.user_id = E.user_id left join golf_tournaments T on T.id = P.tournament_id left join golf_golfers G on G.id = P.golfer_id left join golf_tournament_results R on R.tournament_id = P.tournament_id and R.golfer_id = P.golfer_id where E.contest_id = #{contestId} order by totalPrizeMoney desc, U.username asc, T.starts_at asc
